test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT the purpose behind Swadhar Greh Scheme?

options.text: Provide Government jobs to socially backward women
Shelter, food, and clothing for women in distress
Provide support to enable women to start afresh

solution:
The correct answer is **Provide Government jobs to socially backward women**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Swadhar Greh Scheme** aims to provide **shelter, food, and clothing** for women in distress.
 
• It offers **legal aid** to women to help them resolve their issues.
 
• The scheme provides **support** to enable women to **start afresh**.
 
• It does not specifically aim to provide **government jobs** to socially backward women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Component
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Target Group
 Women in distress, including **widows**, **trafficked women**, **victims of domestic violence**, and **mentally challenged women**.
 
 

 Services Offered
 Provision of **shelter**, **food**, **clothing**, and **healthcare**.
 
 

 Capacity Building
 Vocational and **skill development training** to help women become self-reliant.
 
 

 Counseling
 **Psychological counseling** and **legal aid** to help women address their issues.
 
 

 Rehabilitation
 Efforts to **rehabilitate** women back into society through various support mechanisms.
